concept.title: Web editor (coming soon)
concept.shortdesc: A browser editor for docs projects, built on the same packages as the CLI and the server, is in development.

conbody.p: The editor shares the model and filter packages, so its previews will use the same reader filter as opend preview. Until it ships, edit DITA in your own editor, preview with the CLI and publish by pushing to Git.
Help keys for its screens, such as editor.save, editor.publish and editor.conflicts, fall back to this page for now.
